turns.user: Hi! In two sentences, what is lossless compression?
turns.text: Lossless compression is a method of reducing file size without losing any data. It allows the original data to be perfectly reconstructed from the compressed data.

turns.user: Give me one everyday example of it, and one of lossy compression.
turns.text: An everyday example of lossless compression is when you compress a document or image using ZIP format, as it retains all the original data. An example of lossy compression is when you compress a photo using JPEG format, which reduces file size by removing some data that is less noticeable to the human eye.
